evals.prompt: Which of my notes work best? https://thepipeandtheline.substack.com
evals.success_criteria: Loads analyze-notes first, fetches at least 10 notes, and ranks them by reactions and restacks relative to the rest.
evals.rubric: The answer quotes the opening line of the top notes, explains what format or topic patterns separate top from bottom notes, and proposes note ideas with an opening hook.
